verses.verse:
लय ताल समावेशः शब्दानुकरणं तथा।
स्वर शक्ति विकाशश्चे त्येतेऽलंकारजा गुणाः।१०४।
verses.text: The inclusion of laya (tempo) and tāla (metric cycle), the imitation of words (śabdānukaraṇa), and the development of the power of the notes (svara-śakti): these are the qualities born of alaṅkāra.

commentary.text: As soon as alaṅkāra (patterned exercise) is discussed, three questions arise in the mind: (1) In how many notes is this alaṅkāra arranged? (2) Of how many mātrās (beats) is this order? (3) What is its special feature with regard to cāl (movement)? It is these very questions that are being answered.

The inclusion of laya (tempo) and tāla (metric cycle) in any alaṅkāra, the imitation of words, and the development of the svara-śaktis (powers of the notes) as befits an alaṅkāra, are given below; they resemble the actions described earlier.

terms.en: tāla — metric cycle with measured beats
laya — tempo, time governed by beats
